summary: The hull reaches the march and cannot stay in the air without time. Hange buys that time and does not come back. The others go on toward the Founder's body.

segments.titleEn: They cannot stay above the light
segments.ja: 船体は、列の光の上で高さを保ってきました。保ってきた燃料が、中心の手前で尽きます。尽きる場所は、巨大な姿が歩く熱の中です。中では、降りて整えなければ次の距離がありません。ない距離を、オニャンコポンは数字で置きます。置く数字を、ハンジが聞きます。聞く顔は、もう回頭ではないと言った顔の続きです。尽きる燃料の前で、誰も港の名を繰り返しません。
segments.en: The hull has been holding its height above the row's light. The fuel that held it runs out before the center. The place it runs out is inside the heat where enormous forms walk. Inside that, there is no next distance unless they land and set the hull in order. Onyankopon sets the distance that is not there in numbers. Hange hears the numbers he sets. The face that hears is a continuation of the face that said they were no longer turning back. Before the fuel runs out, nobody repeats the port's name.

segments.ja: 降りた地面は、壁から出た巨人たちの通り道です。通り道を、船体が再び離れるまで塞がなければなりません。塞ぐ相手は、一人では列になりません。なりません。それでも、誰かが時間を買わなければ、乗っている者は熱の中で終わります。終わる計算を、ハンジは自分の席に置きます。置く計算は、団長が最後に出す数です。出す数は、団の最後の人数より小さいです。
segments.en: The ground they land on is the road of the giants that came out of the walls. The road must be held until the hull can leave again. The opponent that holds it does not become a row by being one person. It does not. Even so, if nobody buys time, the people aboard end inside the heat. Hange sets the calculation of ending on her own seat. The calculation she sets is the last count a commander puts out. The count she puts out is smaller than the corps' last number of people.

segments.ja: ハンジは、船体にもう乗らないと言います。言う理由は、時間を買う役が自分だ、です。だ、を、リヴァイは止めようとします。止めようとする手が、狭い視界のまま伸びます。伸びた手を、彼女は振り切りません。振り切らない別れは、短いです。短い別れのあと、彼女は歩く姿のほうへ向かいます。向かう詳細を、今日の話は手順にしません。向かう背中を、リヴァイは視界の端で追います。
segments.en: Hange says she will not board the hull again. The reason she says it is that the role of buying time is hers. Levi tries to stop that. The hand that tries to stop it reaches out with his narrow sight. She does not shake off the hand that reached. The parting that does not shake it off is short. After the short parting, she heads toward the walking forms. Today's story does not turn the detail of heading there into a procedure. Levi follows the back that heads there, at the edge of his sight.

segments.ja: 時間が買われたあと、ハンジは船体に戻りません。戻らない結果だけを、今日は置きます。置く結果を、リヴァイは音が消えたことで知ります。知る耳は、息を守ってきた側の耳です。耳が拾うのは、もう団長の声ではありません。ではありません。熱の向こうで、船体が再び浮く音です。浮く音を、乗っている者は歓声にはしません。歓声にしない静けさが、ハンジの席を空にします。空になった席を、リヴァイは名前で呼びます。
segments.en: After the time is bought, Hange does not return to the hull. Today sets down only the result of not returning. Levi knows the result that is set down because the sound disappeared. The ear that knows is the ear on the side that guarded the breath. What the ear picks up is no longer the commander's voice. It is not. It is the sound of the hull lifting again beyond the heat. The people aboard do not make the sound of lifting into a cheer. The quiet that is not a cheer empties Hange's seat. Levi calls the emptied seat by name.

segments.en: The hull alone cannot place everybody as far as the center's bone. Falco's winged form ties the people it cannot place. The people it ties are Annie, Reiner, and the side that moves on the ground. The detail of the side that moves is not a procedure. It is not. What it sets down is that Gabi again did not let go of the sleeve. The boy who was not let go carries them above the heat. After he carries them, he still has a person's voice left. The person's voice that remained is smaller than the wind of the wings.

segments.en: Around the Founder's body, forms of past Titans are standing. The forms that are standing are the old faces of today's warriors. Annie and Reiner look at the old faces as the shape of their own guilt. They do not present a name to each form they look at. They do not. What it sets down is that the past is blocking the road. Pieck slips the past that blocks it, by speed. Each time she slips it, the bone of the center grows nearer. The bone that grows nearer is larger than the shape of guilt.

Without denying it, he says he will go as far as the place that can arrive. The place he says is on the enormous trunk. On the enormous trunk, the regret can still become words. He sets the words that can become that beside Jean's thinness.

segments.en: Mikasa carries neither conversation nor a stop as a finished word. Without carrying one, she heads to the center. The feet that run while knowing pass through the forms of the past.
